Riffle is not a fork.

Riffle is the echo that refuses to die.

Born on the XRPL at the exact moment the circulating supply kissed 60 billion, Riffle is the living ripple that XRP itself leaves behind. Where XRP is the calm, unstoppable current of global settlement, Riffle is the playful splash!
